# Cave Pony v0.1.1 — public preview

Cave Pony is an MIT-licensed coding-agent skill for the smallest trustworthy change: **do less, say less, prove enough**.

This patch release improves clarity and tagged-version onboarding. It is a **public prerelease**, not a stable v1.0 release or a claim that Cave Pony is proven to improve agent behaviour.

## Changes since v0.1.0

- Clarified the footprint ladder: when multiple options solve the present requirement, choose the **earliest applicable rung**, not a potentially larger one.
- Made the immutable v0.1.1 tag the default installation route in the repository and skill READMEs.
- Aligned version metadata, installation instructions, status documents, and contract tests.
- Kept the existing safety, audit, build/voice controls, provenance, and no-comparative-claims policy intact.

## Install this exact version

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.1.1 https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony.git
npx --yes skills@1.5.9 add "$PWD/cave-pony/skills/cave-pony"
```

Select your host and project/user scope. Read [SKILL.md](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/blob/v0.1.1/skills/cave-pony/SKILL.md) before installation. No Cave Pony runtime package or API credentials are required.

## Release proof and limits

The release workflow checks the exact source commit with repository validation and tests, clean Codex project installation, and public tagged-archive equality before publishing these notes. [CI](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/actions/workflows/ci.yml) is the source of run results.

The written safety contract and successful installation **do not prove model behaviour**. Independent real-repository usage and authenticated Codex behaviour testing remain open in [issue #21](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/issues/21). GitHub social-preview verification remains open in [issue #23](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/issues/23).

Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw installation layouts have been exercised as documented, but behavioural support is not certified. Cave Pony is independently authored, inspired by Ponytail and Caveman, and is not an official fork, successor, or endorsed project.

Failures, neutral cases, and constructive feedback are welcome via [issues](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/issues) and the [field-test template](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/blob/v0.1.1/field-tests/TEMPLATE.md).
